scope: Assistant-authored exploratory transfer controls; new rule families, not independent educational ground truth
background: Ordinary reading comprehension, exact arithmetic, and applying explicitly supplied substitution or if/then instructions. No Rivo or Mera rules are assumed.
scoring: Exact status matches; all planned cases retained; invalid/schema/transport failures are not correct withholding; supported and missing support/givens counted separately.
freeze: References and cases written before inference; no mid-run tuning
